dct_description_sm: This dataset includes accuracy (percentage of targets correctly identified) and response time (time to touch the item that changed colour in milliseconds) from a multiple-object tracking task. Participant basic demographic information is also included.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Visually guided mouse clicking interferes with multiple-object tracking
